text: Mike Ellis, Chair, Robbie International Soccer Tournament, will provide an update on the advancement of soccer in Scarborough.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director of Parks, Forestry and Recreation to report to Scarborough Community Council on the feasibility of re-installing the Robbie International Soccer tournament sign at Birchmount Stadium, and other ways the City can assist the organizers of the Robbie Tournament.
